additional_info.subject: ID0399615-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / PN 312569868/10] Missing power converter CRM:00579001406
additional_info.body:
Hello team,
I trust this email finds you in good health. We have received a technical support request from
ENGIE VIANEO
in your region regarding the following product:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
Y2 / PN 312569868/10
Charger ID/Serial No.:
rjge5U
Problem Description:
Missing power converter
Troubleshooting:
Found following error flag
1.Please check if the power converter are properly connection to its shelf case.
2. Check for any loose connection of any power cable or CAN communication cables of the converter and measured the voltage across it with the help of multimeter. Check the resistance across CAN communication cables.
3. Please see to the display of the power converter whether it is OFF state or ON?
4. If all the steps are performed and you still see the power converter is faulty, we suggest you to replace it.
Attached KA for your reference:
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_Sicharge_D_Converter_ Missing converter in DC1,DC2,DC3,DC4 - (dynamics.com)
Upon reviewing our asset database, we found that the product is no longer under warranty since 2/18/2024, as a result, we are transferring the case to the regional queue.
Kindly communicate with the customer and provide the necessary service support and/or offer. We have already informed the customer that a regional representative will be in touch shortly.
Should you require further remote or expert support, please order it via PMD.
For additional information, please visit the Service Collaboration SharePoint. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Vaishnavi Raut
Please do not change the subject of this Email when replying to it
